content.text: Submitted. The proposal now sits at the preferred level as a single concise insertion after Section 15, which passed the official minimality gate (the prior whole-clause rewrite failed both the word-expansion and 0.600 changed-character limits). The existing mutual consent requirement and affiliate carve-out are preserved byte-for-byte and supply two elements as already met; the inserted sentence adds only the Client merger/acquisition/sale-of-substantially-all-assets carve-out, the not-unreasonably-withheld standard on our consent to a TrueLink assignment, the competitor bar, and the no-termination-on-change-of-control point, with all flagged surplus wording removed.
